The alternate path 'Away.RISK.Crossing' is a rejected naming form.","human_question":null,"members":[{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-HUMAN-RULINGS-001::ATOM-HUMAN-RULINGS-DIRECT-0063","disposition":"basis"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-MSID-GRAMMAR-001::ATOM-MSID-DIRECT-0060","disposition":"basis"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-MSID-GRAMMAR-001::ATOM-MSID-DIRECT-0062","disposition":"supporting"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-MSID-GRAMMAR-001::ATOM-MSID-DIRECT-0254","disposition":"supporting"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-MSID-GRAMMAR-001::ATOM-MSID-DIRECT-0257","disposition":"supporting"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-PA-001::ATOM-PA-DIRECT-0254","disposition":"supporting"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-PA-001::ATOM-PA-DIRECT-0255","disposition":"supporting"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001::P-B00450-1","disposition":"elaboration"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-MSID-GRAMMAR-001::ATOM-MSID-DIRECT-0161","disposition":"elaboration"}],"primary_msid":"Away.Crossing","rationale":"The Human Rulings atom controls the exact question of Crossing's operator, substantive MSID, and world manifestation, stating operator RISK, MSID Away.Crossing, and Highway as world manifestation. The MSID Grammar entry for Away.Crossing corroborates this with an explicit frontmatter block naming operator RISK and world_manifestation World.Highway. Governing Philosophy and MSID Grammar restatements are compatible partial claims that repeat this identity without adding new authority. The Authorial Grammar example illustrates the plain pre-formal activity that becomes Crossing/RISK. The rejected path 'Away.RISK.Crossing' is included as an excluded alternative that confirms rather than contradicts the canonical form.","related_local_ids":["U002","U003","U004"],"unit_local_id":"U001","unit_status":"reconciled"},{"authority_basis_atom_keys":["M050-SRC-HUMAN-RULINGS-001::ATOM-HUMAN-RULINGS-DIRECT-0064","M050-SRC-HUMAN-RULINGS-001::ATOM-HUMAN-RULINGS-DIRECT-0065"],"canonical_claim":"Away.Crossing is uniquely forked by Core Species (Mouse, Rabbit, Squirrel) in a way no other Register is: each species' body produces a materially different procedural grammar for planning, safety, route, timing, and motion, while all remain branches of one Register bound by the same constitutional shape—the party acts through RISK, commits to a plan, crosses as one undertaking, and receives whole-party resolution with particular consequence attached to particular Citizens. The same highway is one underlying simulation, but each Core Species exposes a different playable truth.","human_question":null,"members":[{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-HUMAN-RULINGS-001::ATOM-HUMAN-RULINGS-DIRECT-0064","disposition":"basis"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-HUMAN-RULINGS-001::ATOM-HUMAN-RULINGS-DIRECT-0065","disposition":"basis"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-MSID-GRAMMAR-001::ATOM-MSID-DIRECT-0067","disposition":"supporting"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-MSID-GRAMMAR-001::ATOM-MSID-DIRECT-0068","disposition":"supporting"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-MSID-GRAMMAR-001::ATOM-MSID-DIRECT-0076","disposition":"supporting"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-MSID-GRAMMAR-001::ATOM-MSID-DIRECT-0124","disposition":"supporting"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-MSID-GRAMMAR-001::ATOM-MSID-DIRECT-0258","disposition":"supporting"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-PA-001::ATOM-PA-DIRECT-0258","disposition":"supporting"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-PA-001::ATOM-PA-DIRECT-0259","disposition":"supporting"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-PA-001::ATOM-PA-DIRECT-0283","disposition":"supporting"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-PA-001::ATOM-PA-DIRECT-0284","disposition":"supporting"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-PA-001::ATOM-PA-DIRECT-0285","disposition":"supporting"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-PA-001::ATOM-PA-DIRECT-0291","disposition":"supporting"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-PA-001::ATOM-PA-DIRECT-0292","disposition":"elaboration"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-PA-001::ATOM-PA-DIRECT-0293","disposition":"elaboration"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-CROSSING-001::ATOM-CROSS-ACCEPTED-0024","disposition":"supporting"}],"primary_msid":"Away.Crossing","rationale":"The Human Ruling atoms control the exact question of whether Crossing's species branches are decorative or substantive, confirming Away.Crossing is both a defined semantic unit and the parent branch for Phase and Core-Species forks, and that Crossing is uniquely species-forked among the Registers. MSID Grammar entries and Governing Philosophy restatements corroborate this as compatible elaboration, describing the branch roots, the rationale for non-decorative forking, and the constraint against flattening confirmed species branches. The Crossing specification's own statement that one simulation yields different playable truths per species is a compatible supporting elaboration, not a competing claim.","related_local_ids":["U001","U003","U013","U015"],"unit_local_id":"U002","unit_status":"reconciled"},{"authority_basis_atom_keys":["M050-SRC-PA-001::ATOM-PA-DIRECT-0256"],"canonical_claim":"Crossing concerns committed action inside immediate spatial danger—observation, route selection, timing, commitment, motion, refuge, burden, and whole-party consequence—and its phases and processes (including Phase, Phase.Planning, Phase.Commitment, Phase.ContinuousRun, Phase.Resolution, Process, and Process.Jostle) live under the substantive MSID Away.Crossing. The dedicated Crossing specification owns the exact phases, execution grammar, adversity, species forks, and tuned procedures.","human_question":null,"members":[{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-PA-001::ATOM-PA-DIRECT-0256","disposition":"basis"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-PA-001::ATOM-PA-DIRECT-0261","disposition":"supporting"}],"primary_msid":"Away.Crossing","rationale":"Governing Philosophy and Architecture describes Crossing's subject matter and explicitly defers exact mechanical ownership to the dedicated Crossing specification, a routing statement rather than a competing mechanical claim; both atoms are compatible partial claims from the same source describing scope and ownership.","related_local_ids":["U001","U002","U004","U013"],"unit_local_id":"U003","unit_status":"reconciled"},{"authority_basis_atom_keys":["M050-SRC-CROSSING-001::ATOM-CROSS-ACCEPTED-0001
